name_en: HV MOS gate charge and switching overlap
name_zh: 高压MOS栅电荷与开关交叠
equation_en: Cgd(v)=80pF/(1+v/20V)^0.5; Qgd=integral Cgd dv; plateau gate current=(Vdrive-Vplateau)/Rg; Vds is the inverse charge law. Eoverlap=integral max(Vds Ichannel-Ron Ichannel^2,0)dt. Qoss=integral Coss dv; Eoss=integral v Coss dv.
equation_zh: Miller电荷由非线性Cgd积分，平台电流决定漏压转换时间；交叠损耗积分扣除瞬时导通基线；Qoss与Eoss分别积分Coss和vCoss。

parameters.all_coefficients: Authored illustrative assumptions; same parameterized device across all Vin classes, no rated-voltage certification.

limits_en: Prescribed staged commutation, not a coupled charge-conserving MOS compact model. Ichannel excludes Coss displacement and diode recovery. Fixed-C Miller appeared in V2 X01; this bench adds nonlinear charge, separate overlap/storage energies and temperature sweeps. No breakdown, avalanche, SOA, gate overshoot or layout extraction. Numerical refinement reduces selected discretization errors, not unknown physical modeling error.
limits_zh: 人为规定阶段的换流模型，非完整电荷守恒MOS紧凑模型；沟道电流不含Coss位移和二极管恢复。V2 X01已有固定电容Miller，本版增强非线性电荷、分离交叠/储能及温度扫描；不含击穿、雪崩、SOA、栅过冲或版图提取。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。
parameter_origin_en: Authored illustrative coefficients; no paper parameter extraction or foundry calibration.
parameter_origin_zh: 系数为人为示意假设；未提取论文参数或校准晶圆厂数据。
numerical_method_en: Stage-wise 32-point Gauss quadrature for overlap energies; display samples unchanged.
numerical_method_zh: 交叠能量按阶段采用32点Gauss积分；显示采样不变。

name_zh: 死区二极管与反向恢复
equation_en: D=(Vout+2 td fs Vf)/Vin; L dIL/dt=Vsw-Vout in HS/dead/LS/dead phases. Qrr=0.5 Ipk trr. Ecomm=Vin Qrr is a separate prescribed bus-energy estimate.
equation_zh: 按死区压降补偿占空比，四阶段积分电感电流；三角恢复电流满足Qrr=Ipk trr/2，另列VinQrr换流能量估算。

parameters.all_coefficients: Authored illustrative assumptions; same parameterized device across all Vin classes, no rated-voltage certification.

limits_en: Periodic ideal CCM waveform; recovery pulse is separate from IL and Vsw. Vin Qrr assumes full bus voltage and is not measured diode heat. No stored-charge transport solution, Coss commutation, gate overlap or ringing. V2 X02 already imposed triangular recovery; V3.2 relates it to dead-time sizing and bus-energy accounting. Numerical refinement reduces selected discretization errors, not unknown physical modeling error.
limits_zh: 周期理想CCM波形；恢复脉冲与IL、Vsw分别计算。VinQrr假定全母线电压，不等同实测二极管热。无载流子输运、Coss换流、栅交叠或振铃。V2 X02已有三角恢复，本版关联死区选取和母线能量核算。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。
parameter_origin_en: Authored illustrative coefficients; no paper parameter extraction or foundry calibration.
parameter_origin_zh: 系数为人为示意假设；未提取论文参数或校准晶圆厂数据。
numerical_method_en: Retained exact periodic piecewise-linear CCM solution; numerical-floor audit.
numerical_method_zh: 保留精确周期分段线性CCM解；审核浮点误差底限。

name_en: Floating bootstrap supply and UVLO margin
name_zh: 浮地自举供电与欠压裕量
equation_en: Gate event: deltaVbs=-Qg/Cboot. On: dVbs/dt=-Iq/Cboot. Off: Cboot dVbs/dt=(Vsource-Vbs)/Rcharge-Iq. Exact exponential recharge and analytical periodic map.
equation_zh: 栅极事件消耗Qg使VBS下降，导通期间静态电流放电，关断期间经充电电阻指数恢复；解析周期映射计算最小电压。

parameters.all_coefficients: Authored illustrative assumptions; same parameterized device across all Vin classes, no rated-voltage certification.

limits_en: VBS is gate-driver supply relative to switching source, not absolute gate voltage. UVLO flags a sizing violation without disabling the prescribed gate-charge pulses. No negative-SW overcharge, diode leakage/recovery, startup recharge sequence, high-side common-mode isolation or high-duty operation qualification. Numerical refinement reduces selected discretization errors, not unknown physical modeling error.
limits_zh: VBS相对开关源极，非绝对栅压；欠压仅标记选值失败，不关闭规定栅电荷脉冲。不含负SW过充、二极管漏电/恢复、启动充电序列、高侧共模隔离或高占空比认证。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。
parameter_origin_en: Authored illustrative coefficients; no paper parameter extraction or foundry calibration.
parameter_origin_zh: 系数为人为示意假设；未提取论文参数或校准晶圆厂数据。
numerical_method_en: Retained exact exponential recharge and affine periodic map; numerical-floor audit.
numerical_method_zh: 保留精确指数充电及仿射周期映射；审核浮点误差底限。

name_zh: 电平移位接收端共模扰动
equation_en: (Crx+Ccm) dVrx/dt+Vrx/Rrx=Ccm dVcm/dt. Compare weak and stronger receiver discharge paths at the same 10 V/ns edge.
equation_zh: 共模电容注入电流经接收端RC产生扰动；在相同10V/ns边沿下比较弱/强泄放路径。
limits_en: Unclamped linear RC susceptibility only. Receiver excursions beyond a real logic rail signal model invalidity/risk; no receiver clamp or latch transistor network is modeled. This is not a level-shifter implementation, isolation test or CMTI certification. Numerical refinement reduces selected discretization errors, not unknown physical modeling error.
limits_zh: 仅未钳位线性RC敏感性；超过实际逻辑电源的电压提示模型适用边界/风险，未建模输入钳位或锁存晶体管。不代表完整电平移位电路、隔离测试或CMTI认证。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。
parameter_origin_en: Authored illustrative coefficients; no paper parameter extraction or foundry calibration.
parameter_origin_zh: 系数为人为示意假设；未提取论文参数或校准晶圆厂数据。
numerical_method_en: Retained analytical RC ramp response and event boundary; numerical-floor audit.
numerical_method_zh: 保留解析RC斜坡响应及事件边界；审核浮点误差底限。

name_zh: 电流检测放大器与延迟比较器
equation_en: Vsense=Rs I; Vtarget=Gain Vsense+Vos; tau dVamp/dt+Vamp=Vtarget. Comparator output asserts after threshold crossing plus 35 ns propagation delay.
equation_zh: 取样电阻电压经有限带宽放大器和确定性失调形成输出；比较器阈值 crossing 后加35ns传播延迟。
limits_en: Low-voltage ground-referenced sensing bench. No HV input/common-mode rating, amplifier saturation, input clamp, blanking, random noise, metastability, shunt inductance or actual cycle-by-cycle turn-off. Delay is assumed, not a guaranteed device specification. Numerical refinement reduces selected discretization errors, not unknown physical modeling error.
limits_zh: 低压地参考检测台；无高压共模额定、放大器饱和、输入钳位、消隐、随机噪声、亚稳态、取样寄生电感及实际逐周期关断。延迟为假设，非器件保证值。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。
parameter_origin_en: Authored illustrative coefficients; no paper parameter extraction or foundry calibration.
parameter_origin_zh: 系数为人为示意假设；未提取论文参数或校准晶圆厂数据。
numerical_method_en: Analytical comparator event times inserted as left/right waveform samples; no changed propagation delay.
numerical_method_zh: 解析比较器事件时刻插入左右极限波形样本；传播延迟不变。

name_en: HV startup supply and hysteretic UVLO
name_zh: 高压启动供电与迟滞欠压锁定
equation_en: Caux dVaux/dt=Istart-Iload-Iclamp; current source has a simple compliance limit. Enable at 9 V, disable at 7 V; an 11 V ideal clamp limits Vaux.
equation_zh: 辅助电容由限流启动源充电，并供给状态相关负载；9V开启、7V关闭，11V理想钳位限制辅助电压。

parameters.all_coefficients: Authored illustrative assumptions; same parameterized device across all Vin classes, no rated-voltage certification.

limits_en: Behavioral startup current source, not a JFET transistor model. The source remains on except for an imposed interruption. No real auxiliary winding handover, high-voltage reliability, clamp SOA, leakage, power-on reset timing or guaranteed start-up range. Numerical refinement reduces selected discretization errors, not unknown physical modeling error.
limits_zh: 启动限流源为行为模型，非JFET晶体管模型；除规定中断外保持开启。不含真实辅助绕组接管、高压可靠性、钳位SOA、漏电、上电复位时序或保证启动范围。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。
parameter_origin_en: Authored illustrative coefficients; no paper parameter extraction or foundry calibration.
parameter_origin_zh: 系数为人为示意假设；未提取论文参数或校准晶圆厂数据。
numerical_method_en: Exact event-aligned constant-current segments, checked against original compliance; 2us display grid with all events retained.
numerical_method_zh: 精确事件对齐恒流分段，检查原顺从电压条件；2µs显示网格并保留全部事件。

name_zh: 开关节点寄生振铃与阻尼
equation_en: Series RLC free response: C dv/dt=i; L di/dt=-v-Ri. Rcritical=2 sqrt(L/C), not the parallel-RLC critical resistance. E=0.5 Cv^2+0.5 Li^2; dE/dt=-Ri^2.
equation_zh: 串联RLC自由响应，临界电阻为2√(L/C)，与并联RLC不同；电场与磁场储能之和按Ri²耗散。
limits_en: Linearized series-RLC surrogate about a bus voltage, not a literal shunt RC snubber design. Initial disturbance amplitude is prescribed. No switching-edge excitation, EMI prediction, nonlinear Coss or snubber recurring power estimate. Do not copy its Rcritical into a real shunt snubber. Numerical refinement reduces selected discretization errors, not unknown physical modeling error.
limits_zh: 母线附近线性化串联RLC替代模型，不是实际并联RC吸收器设计；初始扰动人为规定。无开关边沿激励、EMI预测、非线性Coss或吸收器周期功率；不得将临界电阻直接用于真实并联吸收器。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。
parameter_origin_en: Authored illustrative coefficients; no paper parameter extraction or foundry calibration.
parameter_origin_zh: 系数为人为示意假设；未提取论文参数或校准晶圆厂数据。
numerical_method_en: Simpson energy integration on a 4x finer internal grid; analytical display waveform unchanged.
numerical_method_zh: 在加密4倍内部网格上用Simpson进行能量积分；解析显示波形不变。

name_en: DC/DC separated losses and thermal budget
equation_en: Matched Coss hard-turn-on energy: Eupper+(Vin Qlower-Elower)=Vin Qoss. Ploss=HS/LS conduction+L copper+channel overlap+Vin Qoss fs+Vin Qrr fs+two Qg Vdrive fs+dead-time diode+control. Solve Thot=Tamb+Rtheta Ploss(Thot). Fixed-loss transient: Thot(t)=Tamb+Ploss Rtheta (1-exp(-t/Rtheta Ctheta)).
equation_zh: 两管相同Coss：高侧放电储能加低侧充电耗散为Eupper+(VinQlower-Elower)=VinQoss；计一次硬导通/周期，另加导通、铜损、沟道交叠、恢复母线估算、两管栅驱、死区和控制损耗；求等效热节点反馈不动点，再计算恒损耗热瞬态。
limits_en: A ledger, not one self-consistent switched electrical/thermal simulation. Two matched Coss curves, one hard upper turn-on per cycle, opposite edge ideal energy redistribution; Coss subterm energies are explanatory and only their sum enters the loss ledger. Overlap includes load-channel current only; Qrr is separate, with no reused full Eon. Vin Qrr is conservative full-bus energy, not diode heat. All heat shares one effective node, not a MOS junction; the thermal transient holds converged loss constant. No core/ESR/reliability/layout loss or measured efficiency. Numerical refinement reduces selected discretization errors, not unknown physical modeling error.
limits_zh: 此为预算表，非完整自洽开关电热仿真；两管Coss相同，每周期一次高侧硬导通，另一边沿假定理想能量再分配；Coss子项能量用于解释，仅其和计入损耗。交叠仅含负载沟道电流，Qrr单列，不重复使用完整Eon。VinQrr为全母线保守能量，非二极管热；所有热量共用一个等效节点，非MOS结温，热瞬态固定收敛损耗。不含磁芯、ESR、可靠性、版图损耗或实测效率。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。
parameter_origin_en: Authored illustrative coefficients; no paper parameter extraction or foundry calibration.
parameter_origin_zh: 系数为人为示意假设；未提取论文参数或校准晶圆厂数据。
numerical_method_en: Improved P01 quadrature, exact piecewise-linear squared-current moments, tighter thermal fixed point; same nine loss terms.
numerical_method_zh: 改进P01积分、分段线性电流的精确均方矩及更紧热不动点容差；仍为相同九项损耗。

name_en: Averaged buck soft-start and current-reference limit
name_zh: 平均Buck软启动与电流参考限幅
equation_en: L di/dt=D Vin-R i-v; C dv/dt=i-v/Rload. PI voltage loop commands a finite-bandwidth current loop. Reference ramps to 12 V in 2 ms; current command clips at 1.6 A with conditional-integration anti-windup.
equation_zh: 平均功率级由电压PI环和有限带宽电流环控制；2ms参考斜坡、1.6A电流指令上限及条件积分抗饱和。

parameters.all_coefficients: Authored illustrative assumptions; same parameterized device across all Vin classes, no rated-voltage certification.

limits_en: Continuous averaged duty, not PWM edges. A current-reference ceiling is not cycle-by-cycle peak protection; high-frequency overshoot, blanking and inductor saturation are absent. P08 switching losses are not inserted into this plant. Saved traces are decimated; energy metrics use every integration step. No sampled-cycle, slope-compensation, subharmonic or hardware-stability prediction. Numerical refinement reduces selected discretization errors, not unknown physical modeling error.
limits_zh: 连续平均占空比，非PWM边沿；电流参考上限不是逐周期峰值保护，无高频过冲、消隐与电感饱和。未将P08开关损耗注入功率级；显示曲线抽取，能量指标使用全部积分步。不预测采样周期、斜坡补偿、次谐波或硬件稳定性。 数值改进降低指定离散误差，不代表未知物理建模误差降低。
parameter_origin_en: Authored illustrative coefficients; no paper parameter extraction or foundry calibration.
parameter_origin_zh: 系数为人为示意假设；未提取论文参数或校准晶圆厂数据。
numerical_method_en: 0.5us RK4 with continuous ramp evaluated at intermediate stages; events align with steps; RK4 energy quadrature; 10us saved grid.
numerical_method_zh: 0.5µs RK4并在中间子步计算连续斜坡；事件与步长对齐；RK4能量积分；10µs保存网格。
